blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) is an important means for loop closure detection in visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). While state-of-the-art VPR and SLAM approaches excel in urban and feature-rich natural environments, the vast and feature-poor environments of extraterrestrial surfaces like on the Moon or Mars pose severe challenges for existing approaches. This paper presents a novel benchmark, VPR-Space, to evaluate VPR capabilities on extraterrestrial surfaces. There are three contributions: (1) We collected sixteen VPR database-query datasets based on existing data from Space Analog Domains (SAD), terrestrial environments that resemble properties of the Moon or Mars. The collection includes a range of challenges regarding environment, viewpoint change, and illumination conditions. (2) To address the ill-posed nature of VPR, we propose a novel approach to generate the ground-truth information in VPR benchmarks. Instead of defining that a query and datbase image show the same place if and only if their camera poses are within fixed position and viewing direction thresholds, we propose to make the decision dependent on whether the match would be valuable in the downstream SLAM task. To avoid the overhead and restrictions of evaluating VPR in-the-loop within SLAM systems, we provide VPR ground-truth (GT) matrices based on the performance of an ensemble of state-of-the-art Relative Pose Estimators (RPE). Under this GT we require a VPR method to identify exactly those image pairs for which a subsequently applied RPE is expected to provide a valuable pose estimate in a SLAM context. (3) We evaluated nine state-of-the-art VPR approaches. The results show considerable room for improvement and indicate directions for future research. We provide a pre-release version of the dataset on github: $\texttt{https://github.com/rfechner/VPR-Space}$
blocks.zh: Visual Place识别(VPR)是视觉同步本地化和绘图(SLAM)中环闭检测的重要手段. 虽然最先进的VPR和SAMM方法在城市和地物丰富的自然环境中表现优异,但月球或火星等地外地表的广阔和地物贫瘠的环境对现有方法构成严重挑战。 本文提出了一个新的基准"VPR-Space",用于评价地外地表的VPR能力. 有三项贡献: (1) 我们根据空间模拟域(SAD)的现有数据收集了16个VPR数据库 -- -- query数据集,地面环境类似于月球或火星的特性。 该汇编包括环境、观点变化和照明条件方面的一系列挑战。 (2) 为解决自愿评估报告的不合理性质,我们建议采用新的方法,在自愿评估报告基准中提供地面真实信息。 与其定义查询和 Datbase 图像显示相同位置, 且只有在相机的相机姿势处于固定位置和查看方向阈值时, 我们提议根据匹配在下游 SAM 任务中是否有价值来决定。 为了避免在SLAM系统内评价自愿评估报告时出现间接费用和限制,我们提供基于最先进的相对Pose估算仪(RPE)的性能的自愿评估报告地面实况矩阵。 在这个GT下,我们要求一种VPR方法来准确识别那些随后应用的RPE将在SLAM背景下提供有价值的外观估计的图像对. (3)我们评价了9个最新版本的自愿评估报告方法。 结果显示了相当大的改进余地并指明了未来研究的方向。 我们提供了在github上的数据集的预发版本:$\textt{https://github.com/rfechner/VPR-Space}$

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Reliable camera-based navigation is an important capability of autonomous mobile systems in GNSS-denied environments such as the surfaces of the Moon and Mars. The potential of, and challenges associated with, such navigation systems have recently been highlighted by the initial success and subsequent crash of the Mars helicopter Ingenuity. A likely cause being the inability of the visual navigation system to find features on the homogeneous surface of Mars [ 17 ] .
In the context of camera-based navigation, Visual Place Recognition (VPR) addresses the problem of identifying matching image pairs between a query set and a database set of images depicting the same places. It is an important component of loop-closure detection in Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) where it enables the correction of accumulated errors of odometry-based trajectory estimates.
Existing SLAM and VPR approaches achieve impressive performance in urban and feature-rich natural environments like forests. However, the visual characteristics of extraterrestrial planetary surfaces, such as those of the Moon or Mars, differ fundamentally from these environments. They more closely resemble Earth’s stone and sand deserts or volcanic sites, exhibiting regolith and topographic structures such as craters and wrinkle ridges. The vast, often homogeneous and feature-poor landscapes, together with harsh illumination conditions can pose severe challenges for image descriptors.
This is illustrated in Fig. 1 , which shows the distributions of descriptor similarities for image pairs depicting either the same place (orange) or different places (blue). The two distributions are even more difficult to separate in the challenging Moon-like environment (right) than in the challenging urban environment (left). Combined with the low error tolerance of space missions, this motivates the need for careful analysis and evaluation of visual navigation algorithms under planetary-like conditions.
blocks.zh:
可靠的以相机为基础的导航是诸如月球和火星表面等全球导航卫星系统所拒绝的环境中自主移动系统的重要能力。 火星直升机智慧号的最初成功和随后的坠毁,最近突出了这种导航系统的潜力和与之相关的挑战。 一个可能的原因是视觉导航系统无法在火星的同质表面找到特征[17].
在基于相机的导航中,Visual Place识别(VPR)解决了在查询集和描绘相同地点的图像数据库集之间识别匹配图像对的问题. 它是同步本地化和绘图(SLAM)中环闭探测的重要组成部分,能够校正基于偏振仪的轨迹估计的累积错误。
现有的SLAM和VPR方法在城市和森林等富于特色的自然环境中取得了令人印象深刻的业绩。 然而,外星行星表面的视觉特征,如月球或火星的视觉特征,与这些环境有着根本的不同. 它们更接近于地球的石头和沙子沙漠或火山遗址,呈现出岩石和地形结构,如陨坑和皱脊。 幅员辽阔、往往单一和地貌贫瘠的景观,加上严酷的照明条件,可能对图像描述器构成严重挑战。
图1说明了这一点,图1显示了描述同一地方(橙色)或不同地方(蓝色)的图像对的描述式相似性的分布. 这两种分布在挑战性的月球般环境(右)中比挑战性城市环境(左)更难分离. 再加上空间飞行任务的低误差容忍度,这就促使有必要对行星类条件下的视觉导航算法进行认真的分析和评价。

blocks.en: Fig. 1 : Image descriptor similarity histograms for Oxford RobotCar day–night [ 25 ] (left) and SPICE-HL³ noon–night [ 28 ] (right). We used Bag-of-Queries [ 2 ] , a SotA VPR method, to compute the descriptors. The distributions in the space analog domain are even less separable than in this challenging urban domain (i.e., there is no similarity threshold which approximately separates the positive and negative matchings).
blocks.zh: 图1:牛津机器人汽车日-夜[25](左)和SPICE-HL3中午-夜[28](右)的图像描述相似度直径图。 我们用Bag-of-Queries [2],一种SotA VPR方法,来计算描述符. 空间模拟域的分布比这个具有挑战性的城市域的分布更难分离(即没有类似阈值,大约将正比和负比分开).

blocks.en: Fig. 2 : Two images of the MADMAX A2–A4 dataset, captured 20m apart. Constructing the VPR-GT by pose thresholding or frustum overlap fails to capture this match, missing out on a potential match. RPEs however are able to estimate a low error relative pose change, making this a desired VPR match.
blocks.zh: 图2 : MADMAX A2–A4数据集的两幅图像,相距20m. 通过设置阈值或frustum重叠来构造 VPR-GT 无法捕捉到此匹配, 在潜在匹配中缺失 。 然而,RPE能够估计出一个较低的误差相对形成变化,使这成为理想的VPR匹配.

blocks.en: Fig. 3 : Two images of the SPICE-HL³ SPAD dawn–night dataset, captured at the same location but with different lighting conditions. Based on pose thresholding or frustum overlap these images should match. Employing a set of SotA RPEs, the minimum rotation error is > 31 ∘ >31^{\circ} ; matching both images is unlikely to result in a correct pose estimate. We argue to label this pair a non-match.
blocks.zh: 图3:SPICE-HL3 SPAD黎明-夜间数据集的两幅图像,在同一地点拍摄,但照明条件不同. 基于姿势阈值或浮雕的重叠,这些图像应当匹配。 使用一组SotA RTE,最小旋转误差为 > 31 ∘ > 31^{\circ};匹配两个图像不太可能产生正确的姿势估计. 我们争吵着说这对不匹配

blocks.en:
In this paper, we present VPR-Space, a benchmark for VPR approaches that provides (1) challenging combinations of curated database and query image sets with planetary-like conditions, and (2) carefully created ground-truth information about which image pairs depict the same place. Both parts are non trivial.
Collecting large amounts of extraterrestrial on-site data is impractical. An established alternative for preparation of space missions is using Space Analog Domains (SADs), areas on the Earth that resemble properties of the Moon or Mars [ 27 ] . Table I lists available SAD-based datasets for the evaluation of SLAM systems.
Sec. III will describe how we selected, manually curated, and preprocessed the available data in order to create representative database and query sets for the VPR-Space benchmark.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍了VPR-Space,这是VPR方法的基准,它提供了(1) 具有挑战性地结合了被整理的数据库和查询的图像集与类似行星的条件,以及(2) 精心制作地面真实信息,说明哪些图像对子描绘同一地方. 两部分都是无关紧要的
收集大量的地外现场数据是不切实际的. 准备空间飞行任务的一个既定替代办法是使用空间模拟域,即地球上类似月球或火星特性的区域[27]。 图表 我列出了可用于评估SLAM系统的现有基于SAD的数据集.
Sec. III将描述我们如何选择、手动整理和预先处理现有数据,以便为VPR-Space基准创建有代表性的数据库和查询集。

blocks.en:
For the second part, creating the ground-truth (GT) information for evaluation of VPR approaches, a major challenge is the ill-posed nature of the VPR problem: There is no unique correct answer whether two images show the same place or not [ 30 ] .
As will be discussed in Sec. II-C , the usual approach to create GT in existing VPR datasets is based on the ground truth pose difference between the two images ( Pose thresholding ) or overlap in field of view with a limited maximum distance ( Frustum overlap ).
In this paper, we propose a different approach to VPR-GT generation: According to [ 10 ] , the quality of a VPR result is driven by its value for the downstream task. To avoid the overhead and restrictions of evaluating VPR in-the-loop within a SLAM system, we propose to use the performance of an ensemble of Relative Pose Estimators (RPE) as an oracle that identifies valuable matches (i.e., the RPE quality is used to generate the GT matrices). This can address two problems of VPR-GT generation in large and open environments, and in environments with very harsh illumination conditions, both common properties of SADs:
blocks.zh:
第二部分,为评估自愿评估报告的方法提供地面真相信息,主要挑战在于自愿评估报告问题的性质不佳: 无论两幅图像是否显示同一位置[30],都没有独特的正确答案.
如Sec. II-C将讨论的那样,在现有的VPR数据集中创建GT的通常方法是基于地面真实性构成两种图像(Pose 阈值 )或视域重叠,最大距离有限(Frustum 重叠 ).
在本文中,我们提出了对VPR-GT生成的不同方法: 根据[10],VPR结果的质量取决于其对下游任务的价值。 为了避免在SLAM系统内评价VPR的即时性能和限制,我们提议使用一组相对的Pose估计器(RPE)的性能作为鉴定有价值的匹配物的神谕(即使用RPE质量生成GT矩阵). 这可以解决VPR-GT生成在大型和开放环境中,以及在非常严酷的照明条件下的两个问题,两者都是SAD的共同属性:

blocks.en: • Problem 1 : Fig. 2 illustrates how two images that can be considered to show the same place but which are taken far apart from one another, do not match when deciding correspondence based on pose distance or frustum overlap. The proposed RPE-GT includes this match if and only if we expect RPE approaches to find a valuable pose transformation. • Problem 2 : Fig. 3 illustrates an example image pair that is taken from the exact same camera pose but due to extreme lighting conditions, a low error relative pose estimate cannot be made. A GT based on pose distance or frustum overlap would include this match, although it would potentially introduce additional errors in a SLAM system.
blocks.zh: • 问题1:图2说明两个可被视为显示同一地点但彼此相隔甚远的图像,在根据姿势距离或襟翼重叠决定通信时如何不匹配。 建议的RTE-GT包括这种匹配,前提是而且只有在我们期望RTE方法能够找到有价值的姿势转变时。 • 问题2:图3说明从完全相同的相机姿势中取出一对样板图像,但由于极端的照明条件,无法作出较低的误差相对姿势估计。 基于姿势距离或胸膜重叠的GT将包含这种匹配,尽管它可能会在SLAM系统中引入额外的错误.

The proposed RPE-GT includes this match if and only if we expect RPE approaches to find a valuable pose transformation.
blocks.zh: 问题1:图2说明了两个可以被认为显示同一地点但彼此相隔甚远的图像,在根据布局距离或frustum重叠来决定通信时如何不匹配. 建议的RTE-GT包括这种匹配,前提是而且只有在我们期望RTE方法能够找到有价值的姿势转变时。

A GT based on pose distance or frustum overlap would include this match, although it would potentially introduce additional errors in a SLAM system.
blocks.zh: 问题2:图3说明了从完全相同的相机姿势中取出的一对实例图像,但由于极端的照明条件,无法得出较低的误差相对姿势估计. 基于姿势距离或胸膜重叠的GT将包含这种匹配,尽管它可能会在SLAM系统中引入额外的错误.

blocks.en:
Sec. III-C will provide details on this RPE-based ground truth creation.
Sec. IV will then evaluate state-of-the-art (SotA) VPR approaches on the proposed benchmark.
In summary, the main contributions of this paper are:
blocks.zh:
第III-C节将提供关于这种基于REPE的地面真相创造的细节。
第IV节随后将评价拟议基准的最新技术(SotA)VPR方法。
总之,本文件的主要贡献是:

blocks.en: 1. VPR-Space , a challenging VPR benchmark for space analog domains, with 16 database-query sequence pairs derived from existing space analog SLAM datasets. 2. We propose and discuss a novel method to construct an application-driven ground truth for VPR. It leverages a set of SotA relative pose estimators to decide whether two images should match. 3. We evaluate nine SotA VPR methods on VPR-Space .
blocks.zh: 1. VPR-Space,是空间模拟域具有挑战性的VPR基准,现有空间模拟SLAM数据集衍生出16个数据库-query序列对. 2. 我们提出并讨论一种新颖的方法,用以构建一个由应用驱动的关于VPR的地面真相。 它利用了一组SotA相对的显示器来决定两个图像是否应该匹配. 3. 我们对VPR-Space上的九种SotA VPR方法进行评估。

blocks.en: VPR-Space , a challenging VPR benchmark for space analog domains, with 16 database-query sequence pairs derived from existing space analog SLAM datasets.
blocks.zh: VPR-Space ,是空间模拟域的具有挑战性的VPR基准,现有空间模拟SLAM数据集衍生出16个数据库-query序列对.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A VPR Datasets and Benchmarks
blocks.zh: II-A VPR 数据集和基准

blocks.en:
VPR is an intensively studied problem and the literature discusses typical challenges such as viewpoint changes (observing places from different camera poses) and appearance changes (e.g., due to varying illumination, weather, or season) [ 30 , 10 , 29 ] . To successfully perform VPR, extracted features must 1) be present in the environment, and 2) be processable (i.e., observable, extractable, describable, and matchable).
Existing VPR datasets cover a broad spectrum of environments and visual dynamics. Datasets like Oxford RobotCar [ 25 ] test VPR in urban domains, capturing the streets of Oxford in different lighting and environmental conditions. The Tokyo 24/7 [ 34 ] dataset shows views of the streets of Tokyo at day and night, additionally introducing the challenge of changing environments. Semi-structured VPR datasets include Nordland [ 32 ] , a railway trip through Norway under changing seasons, or WildCross [ 20 ] , a recent dataset addressing the gap of cross-modal VPR in natural domains. To evaluate general performance, VPR benchmarks aggregate these distinct domains. For example, VPR-Bench [ 40 ] combines a mix of indoor and outdoor (urban and semi-structured) VPR datasets to provide a balanced assessment across varied scenarios. However, existing benchmarks predominantly reflect terrestrial features (e.g., roads, vegetation, and man-made structures).
blocks.zh:
VPR是一个深入研究的问题,文献讨论了典型的挑战,如观点变化(从不同的相机姿势观察位置)和外观变化(例如,由于光照、天气或季节的不同)[30、10、29]。 为了成功地进行VPR,提取的特性必须1)存在于环境中,2)是可处理的(即可观测的、可提取的、可降解的和可匹配的)。
现有的VPR数据集涵盖广泛的环境和视觉动态. 牛津机器人车[25]等数据集在城市域测试VPR,捕捉牛津不同照明和环境条件下的街道. 东京24/7 [34] 数据集显示东京街头昼夜景色,还引入了改变环境的挑战. 半结构的VPR数据集包括Nordland [32],在变化的季节下穿越挪威的铁路旅行,或者WildCross [20],这是最近解决自然域跨模式VPR差距的数据集. 为了评估总体业绩,自愿评估报告的基准将这些不同的领域综合起来。 例如,VPR-Bench [40]结合了室内和室外(城市和半结构)的VPR数据集,以提供不同情景的均衡评估. 然而,现有基准主要反映地面特征(如道路、植被和人造结构)。

blocks.en: II-B SLAM Space Datasets
blocks.zh: II-B 苏丹解放军 空间数据集

blocks.en:
Although, to the best of our knowledge, no dedicated SAD VPR datasets are available, Table I provides properties of existing SLAM Space datasets that will be used for VPR benchmark construction in Sec. III .
We want to highlight four particularly relevant datasets. The MADMAX dataset [ 26 ] captures 36 trajectories on 8 different sites near the city of Erfoud, Morocco. The collected trajectories depict dunes, coarse stone desert and traverses along and over rock-structures. The S3LI Etna dataset [ 13 ] was collected around the crest and in close proximity of Mt. Etna, Italy. The sequences collected along the crater ridge depict grayscale imagery of volcanic rock and ash, a very monotonous landscape. The LunarLoc dataset [ 33 ] publishes 17 sequences along a 27m by 27m simulated lunar landscape, consisting of images collected with a digital twin of the NASA IPEx rover. The recently published SPICE-HL³ dataset [ 28 ] was collected at the LunarLab in Luxembourg. It includes a particularly relevant traverse that follows a stop-and-capture routine with several sequences of the same fixed trajectory, each sequence providing differently illuminated images.
blocks.zh:
虽然据我们所知,没有专门的SAD VPR数据集,但表一提供了现有的SAM空间数据集的属性,这些数据集将用于Sec.III中的VPR基准构建.
我们要强调四个特别相关的数据集。 MADMAX数据集 [26] 拍摄摩洛哥埃尔福德市附近8个不同地点的36个轨迹. 收集的轨迹描绘了沙丘,粗糙的石头沙漠和沿岩石结构和过岩结构的穿越. S3LI Etna数据集[13]是在山峰周围和意大利埃特纳山附近采集的. 沿陨坑山脊收集的序列描绘了火山岩和火山灰的灰度图像,这是一个非常单调的景观. LunarLoc数据集 [33] 发布沿27m乘27m模拟月球景观的17个序列,由使用NASA IPEx rover数字双子采集的图像组成. 最近公布的SPICE-HL3数据集[28]在卢森堡的LunarLab收集. 它包括一个特别相关的转弯道,它遵循一个截断和截断的常规,有数个固定轨迹的序列,每个序列提供不同的照明图像。

blocks.en: II-C Approaches to Construct a VPR-GT
blocks.zh: II-C 构建VPR-GT的方法

blocks.en:
Constructing the VPR-GT requires the critical decision of which images should match in the first place, a topic discussed at length by Schubert et al. [ 30 ] . Adjacently, Garg et al. [ 10 ] name “drivers” as the motivators for forming the VPR-GT.
The established VPR benchmarks usually construct their VPR ground truths based on the distance in poses between two images or match individual images based on frame index. For example, the Tokyo 24/7 dataset [ 34 ] decides correspondence based on GPS distance of collected images; a found database image is a positive if it was captured at most 25m away from the query image. The Nordland dataset [ 32 ] matches image pairs based on their frame index, as database and query pairs are collected along the same trajectory and time-synchronized. A recent work on benthic VPR [ 23 ] uses an evaluation that is closer to the downstream task. The approach estimates 3D footprints on the seafloor and determines a top-down feature overlap to decide whether two images correspond to the same VPR-place. In a similar direction, the authors of the S3LI Vulcano dataset [ 12 ] mention the possibility to calculate VPR ground truths from point-cloud overlaps, when LiDAR or precise depth maps are available. They describe a VPR-GT construction built on shared visible information in the frustum but leave the construction of a decision rule to future work.
blocks.zh:
构建VPR-GT需要关键决定哪一个图像首先应该匹配,这个话题由舒伯特等人详细讨论. [30]. 相近的是,Garg等人[10]将“驾驶员”命名为形成VPR-GT的动力。
既定的VPR基准通常根据两个图像之间的姿势距离来构建其VPR地面真相,或者根据帧指数来匹配单个图像. 例如,东京24/7数据集[34]根据采集到的图像的GPS距离决定通信;找到的数据库图像如果在距查询图像最多25米的地方被捕获,则是一个正数. 诺德兰数据集[32]根据它们的帧指数匹配图像对,因为数据库和查询对按照相同的轨迹和时间同步来收集. 最近一项关于底栖VPR[23]的工作采用了更接近下游任务的评价. 该方法估计海底的3D足迹,并确定自上而下的特征重叠,以确定两个图像是否对应同一个VPR位置. 在类似方向上,S3LI Vulcano数据集的作者[12]提到,当有LiDAR或精确的深度地图时,可以从点-云重叠处计算出VPR的地面真理. 他们描述了VPR-GT建筑,该建筑基于共同的可见信息,但将决策规则的建造留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: III Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 三. 基准建设

blocks.en: A VPR benchmark for SADs should include a diverse set of challenging scenarios and environments which can be used to gain a holistic understanding of the capabilities of a VPR method in SADs. We see four major design requirements for such a benchmark: (1) It should resemble relevant and established VPR challenges like Viewpoint Change (VC) and Illumination Change (IC) [ 29 ] . (2) It should include a diverse set of space analog environments and topologies, representing both, Mars- as well as Moon-analog domains. (3) It should have an application relevant VPR-GT which addresses the specific challenges of the domain. (4) It should challenge the SotA for VPR. In the following, we will show how VPR-Space meets these requirements.
blocks.zh: 工代的自愿评估报告基准应包括一套不同的具有挑战性的假设情景和环境,可用来全面了解工代的自愿评估报告方法的能力。 我们看到这一基准的四项主要设计要求: (1) 它应类似于Videopoint Change(VC)和Illumnation Change(IC)[29]等相关和既定的VPR挑战。 (2) 它应当包括代表火星和月球等一系列不同的空间模拟环境和地形。 (3) 它应有一个涉及该领域具体挑战的VPR-GT应用程序。 (4) 它应当对《联邦宪法》提出质疑。 在下文中,我们将展示VPR-Space如何满足这些要求。

blocks.en: Fig. 4 : An overview of the database (blue) and query (red) sequences of the VPR-Space benchmark. We show example matches from both sequences to illustrate the shape of the task. For SPICE-HL³, database and query sequence lie on top of each other.
blocks.zh: 图4:VPR-Space基准数据库(蓝色)和查询(红色)序列概览. 我们从两个序列中显示实例匹配,以说明任务的形状。 对于SPICE-HL3,数据库和查询序列位于对方之上.

blocks.en: III-A Choosing Database and Query Sequences
blocks.zh: III-A 选择数据库和查询序列

blocks.en:
From the available datasets in Table I , we select 16 sequence pairs in total. Trajectory shapes and example images can be seen in Figure 4 . We identify ten pairs of diverse and challenging database and query sequences falling into the VC category – six from MADMAX and two from S3LI and LunarLoc respectively. These pairs contain changing viewpoints of the same place. They are distinct sequences collected at the same site with crossover points and intervals. For the VPR challenge of IC we chose six pairs of sequences from SPICE-HL³’s A trajectory. The sequences follow a fixed trajectory but differ in lighting, camera sensor and exposure time. For the two cameras, one monochrome and one Single Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD), we chose three main setups: dawn–night, noon–night and dawn–noon.
We apply a sub-sampling routine to achieve an even distribution of data points across the trajectories. Details can be found in the Appendix.
Overall, this selection satisfies our design requirements (1) and (2), as it consists of 10 VC and 6 IC setups, balances Mars- and Moon-analogs, has different trajectory topologies and geological environments.
blocks.zh:
从表一的现有数据集中,我们总共选择了16个序列对. 图4显示了轨迹形状和实例图像。 我们发现十对属于VC类的多样且具有挑战性的数据库和查询序列,其中六对分别来自MADMAX和S3LI和LunarLoc。 这些对子包含了同一地点不断变化的观点. 它们是在同一地点收集的具有交叉点和间隔的不同序列。 我们从SPICE-HL3的A轨迹中选择了六对序列。 序列遵循固定轨迹,但在照明、相机传感器和曝光时间方面有所不同。 我们选择了三种主要设定:黎明-夜晚、中午-夜晚和黎明-中午。
我们采用子抽样常规,实现数据点在轨迹上的均匀分布. 详见附录.
总的来说,这一选择符合我们的设计要求(1)和(2),因为它包括10个VC和6个IC设置,平衡了火星和月球矩阵,具有不同的轨道地形和地质环境。

blocks.en: III-B Data Cleaning
blocks.zh: 三-B 数据清理

blocks.en: Our VPR-GT construction requires correct ground-truth camera poses in order to evaluate the result of an RPE. During initial data analysis, we noticed inconsistencies in the provided poses and imagery and decided to manually verify the selected sequences. In MADMAX and S3LI Etna we encountered GNSS and IMU errors, in the SPICE-HL³ sequences we observed some camera artifacts. We verified the data with three independent human annotators, using a shared labeling UI where position, orientation and associated image are visible. Any data point being (a) visually corrupted or (b) exceeding an apparent GT pose error beyond 1 meter in position or 10° in orientation was flagged. Out of about 9200 flagged data points, the three annotators agree on about 72%; at least two annotators agree on 81% of the flagged data points. We discarded every frame flagged by at least one annotator. The found errors are provided as part of the published data, so that they can be reused by others working with the raw data.
blocks.zh: 我们的VPR-GT建造需要正确的地面真实相机,以便评估一个RTE的结果。 在初步数据分析中,我们注意到所提供的姿势和图像不一致,并决定人工核实选定的序列。 在MADMAX和S3LI Etna中,我们遇到全球导航卫星系统和IMU错误,在SPICE-HL3序列中,我们观测到一些相机文物。 我们用三个独立的人类注释员验证了数据,使用一个共享的标注UI,其中位置,方向和相关图像可见. 标出的任何数据点是:(a) 视觉损坏或(b) 超过明显GT的误差超过1米的位置或方向10°。 在大约9200个标注数据点中,三个标注者同意约72%;至少两个标注者同意81%标注数据点. 我们抛弃了至少一个注释员标出的每个框架。 发现的误差作为已公布数据的一部分提供,以便其他从事原始数据工作的人可以重复使用.

blocks.en: III-C Construction of the VPR Ground Truth
blocks.zh: III-C 建设VPR地面真相

blocks.en:
The VPR ground truth is usually represented by discrete sets of matching image pairs from query and database sets, e.g., in form of a ground-truth matrix [ 29 ] .
We propose to create this matrix using an ensemble of available SotA Relative Pose Estimator approaches that serve as an oracle to tell whether a valuable pose estimate could be obtained from an image pair in a SLAM downstream task.
The RPE ensemble is used in combination with ground-truth pose information. Instead of directly judging the ground-truth pose distance between a query and a database image, we evaluate the error between the output of the RPEs and the ground-truth pose transformation to decide whether an image pair is valuable in a SLAM context (and thus should be found by an VPR approach).
We want to emphasize that, in contrast to an actual end-to-end evaluation in a SLAM system, this oracle has to be used only once for each image pair and not for each evaluated VPR approach.
blocks.zh:
VPR的地面真象通常通过从查询和数据库集中分离的一组匹配的图像对来代表,例如以地面真象矩阵的形式[29].
我们建议使用一系列可用的SotA相对Pose估计器方法来创建这一矩阵,这些方法可以用来判断是否可以从SLAM下游任务中的图像组合中获取有价值的配置估计值。
REPE综艺节目与地面真实布局信息结合使用. 我们不是直接判断地面真实值在查询和数据库图像之间的距离,而是评价实时设备输出与地面真实值之间的误差,从而决定图像对在SLAM背景下是否具有价值(因此应该通过VPR方法找到)。
我们想强调,与SLAM系统中的实际端到端评价不同,这个甲骨文只能用于每对图像,而不能用于每对评估的VPR方法。

blocks.en:
We construct a majority voting scheme over multiple RPEs. We leverage off-the-shelf monocular metric-relative pose estimation pipelines that predict a 6DoF relative pose consisting of rotation and scaled translation.
Where applicable, backbone architectures are provided with metric depth predictions from Depth Anything V2 [ 38 ] and refined using RANSAC [ 8 ] . Our evaluation ensemble comprises DUSt3R [ 36 ] , MUSt3R [ 6 ] , MapAnything [ 19 ] , MADPose [ 39 ] , and a SuperPoint [ 7 ] + LightGlue [ 24 ] combination.
blocks.zh:
我们构建了一个多数投票计划,对多个生殖健康项目进行投票。 我们利用现成的单体计量关系估计管道,预测6DoF的相对位置,包括旋转和缩放翻译。
在适用的情况下,主干结构得到深度任意V2[38]的测量深度预测,并使用RANSAC[8]加以改进。 我们的评价组合包括DUST3R [36],MUST3R [6],MapAnything [19],MADPose [39],以及一个超级点. [7] + LightGlue [24] 组合.

blocks.en: Building upon this majority voting mechanism, we can vary the error thresholds τ R , τ t \tau_{R},\tau_{t} , and n n to construct distinct soft- and hard- correspondence matrices required for a VPR evaluation. We follow the work of Schubert et al. [ 29 ] where the soft ground truth denotes matches outside the hard ground truth which should not be penalized when an algorithm retrieves them. Exact hyperparameter choices and resulting dataset statistics are provided in the Appendix. Figure 5 compares this approach to constructing the VPR-GT based on pose thresholding or frustum overlap.

blocks.en: IV Evaluation of SotA VPR approaches
blocks.zh: 四. 对SotA VPR方法的评估

blocks.en: IV-A Quantative Analysis
blocks.zh: IV-A 定量分析

blocks.en: We evaluate MegaLoc [ 5 ] (MeLo), Bag-of-Queries [ 2 ] (BoQ), SALAD [ 16 ] (SLD), AnyLoc [ 18 ] with the global vocabulary (AnyL), AnyLoc with the unstructured vocabulary, MixVPR [ 1 ] , CosPlace [ 4 ] as well as DenseVLAD [ 34 ] (DenV), NetVLAD [ 3 ] and DINOv3 (CLS token) [ 31 ] as baselines. We standardize with the database statistics and L2-normalize all descriptors before constructing the similarity matrices. We report the Area under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUPRC) in Table II and Recall@ { 1 , 5 , 10 } \{1,5,10\} as well as Recall@100p (recall at 100% precision) in Table III . The tables do not include AnyLoc with the unstructured vocabulary, MixVPR, CosPlace and DINOv3 as these methods didn’t score highest on any of the datasets; fully detailed results will be made available on the benchmark website.
blocks.zh: 我们评价MegaLoc [5] (MeLo), Bag-of-Queries [2] (BoQ), SALAD [16] (SLD), AnyLoc [18] 全球词汇(AnyL), AnyLoc 无结构词汇(AnyL), MixVPR [1], CosPlace [4] 以及 DenseVLAD [34] (DenV), NetVLAD [3] 和 DINOV3(CLS sorder) [31] 作为基线. 我们在构建相似性矩阵之前,将数据库统计数据标准化,并将所有描述符L2规范化。 我们在表二中报告精确召回曲线下的区域(AUPRC)和召回@{1、5、10}1、5、10 以及召回@100p(100%召回)在表三中报告。 这些表格不包括无结构词汇的AnyLoc、MixVPR、CosPlace和DINov3,因为这些方法在任何一个数据集中都得分不高;详细结果将在基准网站上公布。

blocks.en: The results indicate significant room for improvement for VPR methods on SAD. Averaged across all datasets, the best performing VPR approach achieves an AUPRC of 0.47 and recall@1 of 0.64 (with values of 0.18 and 0.38, respectively, for the most challenging dataset). Noticeable, in the worst case, a mode especially important for autonomous missions, R@100p is near zero across all methods.
blocks.zh: 结果显示,在对单一分配法采用自愿延期审查方法方面,有很大的改进余地。 在所有数据集中平均而言,最佳的VPR方法的AUPRC为0.47,召回@1为0.64(最具有挑战性的数据集的数值分别为0.18和0.38)。 值得注意的是,在最坏的情况下,一种对自主任务特别重要的模式,R@100p在所有方法中几乎为零。

blocks.en: Although being finetuned on urban data, Bag-of-Queries and MegaLoc demonstrate domain adaptation, as can be seen by their performance on the MADMAX A0 – A2, MADMAX F0 – F3, and SPICE-HL³ dawn – noon pairs in Table II . Except for setups where outlines and shadows are quite similar, such as in SPICE-HL³’s dawn – noon pairings, current VPR methods struggle when the difference in lighting becomes too large. Notably, DenseVLAD, a non deep learning method, performs best on SPICE-HL³-SPAD-dawn-noon.
blocks.zh: 虽然在城市数据上微调,Bag-of-Queries和MegaLoc演示了域名适应,从他们在MADMAX A0–A2,MADMAX F0–F3以及SPICE-HL3黎明的表演中可以看到他们在表二中的午配对. 除了轮廓和阴影非常相似的设定,例如SPICE-HL3的黎明 — — 午配对,当照明的差别太大时,当前的VPR方法会挣扎. 值得注意的是,DenseVLAD是一种非深层学习方法,在SPICE-HL3-SPAD-dawn-noon上表现最好.

blocks.en: IV-B Qualitative Analysis: What are hard queries that the SotA cannot solve yet?
blocks.zh: 四-B 定性分析: SotA尚不能解决的难题是什么?

blocks.en: Three examples from the analysis of the BoQ results can be seen in Figure 6 . One common pattern can be seen in Figure 6(b) : in SAD and other domains with large and open spaces, images along a straight sequence with a shared horizon tend to have high similarity. This is especially relevant as image pairs of this failure mode may pass the geometric verification stage and hence produce a relative pose estimate with large error.
blocks.zh: 图6显示了分析BoQ结果的三个例子。 图6(b)中可以看到一个常见的图案:在具有大空间和开放空间的SAD和其他域中,沿有共同视野的直线序列的图像往往具有高度相似性. 这一点尤其相关,因为这种故障模式的图像对可能通过几何校验阶段,从而产生一个大错的相对姿势估计.

blocks.en: V Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: Both RPEs and VPR methods rely on visual overlap; RPEs to determine a relative pose and VPR methods to produce an embedding. They may share failure modes, which would exaggerate performance in SAD. To this end, Figure 3 can be interpreted as a possible limitation of our approach: Even though camera poses coincide, we do not require a match. However, we want to emphasize that our proposed VPR-GT is driven by the domain of interest and possible downstream application in a SLAM context. This results in a different notion of which matches should and should not be found.
blocks.zh: RPE和VPR方法都依赖于视觉重叠;RPE确定相对姿势,VPR方法生成嵌入. 它们可能共享失败模式,这将夸大SAD的表现. 为此,图3可被解释为对我们方法的可能限制: 虽然相机摆着相机 但我们不需要火柴 然而,我们想强调,我们提议的自愿终止妊娠方案是由利益领域驱动的,并可能在下游应用在斯里兰卡解放运动背景下。 这造成一种不同的概念,即应该而且不应该找到匹配点。

blocks.en:
Further, our VPR-GT is constructed to go beyond the capabilities of any one RPE, using a voting mechanism to increase robustness.
As available RPEs improve or the expected characteristics of the downstream task change, RPE-based GT matrices may be updated. We refer to the GT used here as “ VPR-GT-RPE-0 ”. If future work uses a modified GT, it should indicate this.
blocks.zh:
此外,我们的VPR-GT的构建超出了任何一个RTE的能力,利用表决机制提高稳健性.
随着现有可再生能源设备的改进或下游任务变化的预期特点,可以更新基于可再生能源设备的全球技术矩阵。 我们这里所说的GT是“VPR-GT-RPE-0......”。 如果未来的工作使用经过修改的GT,应当注明这一点.

blocks.en: Although spatial verification stages and robust SLAM optimization back-ends reduce the influence of false-positive matchings [ 29 ] , under the proposed GT, they gain relevance again (and so do AUPRC and R@100p metrics that explicitly incorporate false positives). Due to the GT construction approach, false positive image pairs are known to produce a large relative pose error. And due to the similar nature of RPE approaches and spatial verification stages, they are also likely to pass this verification stage.
blocks.zh: 虽然空间核查阶段和强大的 SLAM 优化后端降低了假阳性匹配的影响[29],但在拟议的GT下,它们再次变得相关(明确包含假阳性内容的 AUPRC和R@100p 度量衡也是如此). 由于GT构建方法,假正图像对已知会产生一个大相对的形成错误. 并且由于REPE方法和空间核查阶段的相似性,它们也有可能通过这个核查阶段.

blocks.en: For brevity, we only evaluated holistic VPR descriptors. However, VPR-Space can also be used for evaluation of local-descriptor-based and hierarchical pipelines.
blocks.zh: 为了简洁起见,我们只评价了综合的自愿评估报告描述。 然而,VPR-Space也可以用于评价基于本地描述和层次的管道.

blocks.en: Finally, we want to make clear that the way we use RPEs for GT generation can not be used to solve the VPR problem itself, since the VPR-GT generation additionally requires GT pose information to evaluate the RPE results.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们要明确,我们使用RPE进行GT生成的方式不能用来解决VPR问题本身,因为VPR-GT生成还需要GT提出信息来评价RTE结果.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: This work presented VPR-Space , a novel VPR benchmark for space analog domains. We selected and curated relevant sequence pairs from existing SLAM Space datasets to represent relevant viewpoint- and illumination-changes. To connect the VPR evaluation to the downstream SLAM task, we proposed to leverage an ensemble of SotA relative pose estimators to compute the VPR ground truth, rewarding VPR retrieval only if a low error pose estimate can be made. The evaluation of SotA VPR methods shows significant headroom for improvement and the qualitative analysis showed concrete failure modes of the VPR SotA. Our hope is that this benchmark sets new goals for VPR developments.
blocks.zh: 这项工作介绍了VPR-Space,这是一个用于空间模拟域的新VPR基准。 我们从现有的SLAM空间数据集中选择并整理了相关序列对,以代表相关观点和光线的变化。 为了将VPR评价与下游的SAM任务联系起来,我们提议利用一个SotA相对的组合来计算VPR的地面真伪,只有在低误差提出估计时才能奖励VPR检索. 对 " SotA VPR " 方法的评价显示,有一个重要的改进前厅,质量分析显示 " SotA " 的具体故障模式。 我们希望,这一基准将为自愿减贫战略的发展确定新的目标。

blocks.en: Sub-sampling routine: Due to different velocities and sampling rates of the sensor platforms, some sequences contain multiple images of the same place. We alleviate this issue by applying a rolling window approach for all but the SPICE-HL³ sequences which do not need this post-processing step. We briefly summarize the sub-sampling routine: The first image of the sequence is added to the result list and becomes the previously added image. Then, for every following image, we check whether the associated Δ \Delta between the previous and current position exceeds 1m or the Δ \Delta in camera-yaw exceeds 10°. In which case we add the current image to the result list and the current image becomes the previous added image.
blocks.zh: 子样本常规 : 由于传感器平台的速度和采样率不同,一些序列包含同一地点的多个图像. 我们通过对除SPICE-HL3序列以外的不需要这一后处理步骤的所有人采用滚动窗口方法来缓解这一问题。 我们简要总结了次级取样程序: 序列的第一个图像被添加到结果列表中,成为之前添加的图像. 然后,我们检查前位置和当前位置之间关联的\\\Delta是否超过1m,或者相机-yaw中的\\Delta是否超过10°。 在这种情况下,我们将当前图像添加到结果列表中,当前图像成为之前添加的图像.
